channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: Michael Shvo ousted from Transamerica Pyramid after second sale of tower in 6 years
item.description: The current ownership group has been under scrutiny for lavish spending and big losses at one of San Francisco’s most recognizable properties.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: Which Warriors can keep this stretch run interesting?
item.description: As Steph Curry deals with a knee injury, Golden State is relying on less heralded players to execute coach Steve Kerr’s system.

item.title: Déjà vu for Trent Williams and 49ers: Inside contract drama and possible resolutions
item.description: At the NFL Combine, GM John Lynch addressed his star left tackle’s status and provided updates on Nick Bosa, Mykel Williams, and Keion White.

item.title: He lives like a monk. He dines like a king
item.description: Michael Grepo, a 67-year-old retired federal worker, has eaten at some of the city’s best restaurants more than 50 times. And he’s still going.

item.title: My idyllic holiday in Mexico became a 72-hour escape from cartel chaos
item.description: Narco violence leaves one Standard reporter wondering how he’d ever get back to SF.

item.title: 19 events in SF this week, from Club Darc to the return of the Sunset Night Market
item.description: Plus, Black History Month and Lunar New Year celebrations, a conversation with Gavin Newsom, a cocktail party with Calvin Hom, and more.

item.title: The house that Michael Shvo built — and lost — in San Francisco
item.description: The impending sale of the Transamerica Pyramid to a Cypriot firm closes a thrilling and tumultuous chapter in the city’s post-pandemic recovery.

item.title: ‘An actual moderate’: Lurie ally and Trump appointee enters race for Pelosi seat
item.description: Marie Hurabiell, director of the moderate group ConnectedSF, aims to appeal to centrist and right-leaning voters.

item.title: She runs AI safety at Meta. Her AI agent still went rogue
item.description: “You’re right to be upset,” OpenClaw’s agent told her later.

item.title: New illuminati list just dropped: A leaked roster of 2,200 Bohemian Grove members
item.description: The full 2023 retreat member list was published by an independent journalist. Many, many Bay Area pooh-bahs are on it.
